model.architecture: granite-4.0-h Mamba2/attention hybrid (32L: 28 mamba + 4 attention, 0.34B) SFT for Arabic diacritization (Misraj/Sadeed_Tashkeela)

variants.quantization: fp16 weights on linears + embedding (convs/SSM fp32) - exact-parity build: task gate 10/10 byte-identical to HF fp32 greedy

platform_notes: Requires litert-lm >= 0.15 (hybrid state binds via ExecutorMetadata)
CPU only: Mamba2 selective-scan ops exceed the mobile GPU delegate's rank limit (family trait)
Prompt contract: user message 'قم بتشكيل هذا النص :\n' + text (the checkpoint's trained form)
Start token dropped: at 350M scale a prepended <|end_of_text|> flips diacritization to garbage (measured)
On phones the CPU runtime unpacks fp16 to fp32 in RAM - prefer int8 on mobile

measured.source: S7 Android backfill: same-device CPU control - identical binary, prompt file and flags, only --backend differs; 205-token prompt with --benchmark, 2 cold runs (compile/weight caches deleted between runs, device cooled below 42 C before each run); the GPU path does not run for this file on this handset, so this row has no GPU counterpart

S7 Android backfill: same-device CPU control - identical binary, prompt file and flags, only --backend differs; 205-token prompt with --benchmark, 2 cold runs (compile/weight caches deleted between runs, device cooled below 42 C before each run); the GPU path was not run for this file on this handset (Mamba2 family trait; GPU gated on the int8 file), so this row has no GPU counterpart

variants.quantization: dynamic int8 (linears + embedding; convs/SSM fp32) - task gate 8/10 vs HF fp32: two single-diacritic greedy flips, both byte-exact on the float parent (quantization cost, the base 350m's documented int8 sensitivity)

recommended.reason: measured on one Galaxy S26 with one binary (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-05, 205-token prompt, 2 cold runs per backend, cooled before each run): cpu decodes 67.2-68.96 tok/s against gpu's 46.29 (1.5x), prefill 192.1-212.1 vs 753.4 tok/s, peak 1110 vs 2256 MB, engine init 1.7 vs 22.8 s. Same-device GPU control taken - a measured win for cpu on decode. Diacritization returns roughly one output token per input token, so decode weight matters as much as prefill: end to end the CPU finishes the 224-token probe sooner, at half the peak memory. The Adreno path itself ran fully delegated and diacritized the probe correctly - the card's 'CPU only (family trait)' does not hold on this handset

measured on one Pixel 8a with one binary (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-05, 205-token prompt, 2 cold runs per backend, cooled before each run): cpu decodes 47.33-49.06 tok/s against gpu's 18.31 (2.6x), prefill 111.8 vs 250.9-263.4 tok/s, peak 1072 vs 3689 MB, engine init 2.2 vs 25.5 s. Same-device GPU control taken - a measured win for cpu on decode. On this Mali phone the GPU path also ran fully delegated and diacritized the probe correctly, so cpu is chosen on speed and memory, not on capability

platform_notes: 38% of the fp16 size - the practical mobile choice
